profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary:
Overall have a love for automated testing, QA and build engineering along with being a big gaming fan. I especially love using Jenkins CI to make development lives easier! Lets automate the world!

6+ years  QA/CQC experience
5+ years of Automated Testing
2+ years of Build Engineering
1+ years of QA Management 

On the side, started making some small time Mobile Games. Links to come in the future!

positions.title: Release Engineer
positions.description: Release Engineer for the mobile game Star Wars: Uprising on iOS, Android, and Amazon. In charge of coordinating releases, handling live data updates, release builds on iTunes Connect, Google Play, Amazon Dev console and build engineering using C# + Ant + Jenkins. Created some light tools using ANT + Jenkins to help Designers easily do data updates.

positions.title: QA Automation/Build Engineer, QA Lead
positions.description:
Filled 2 roles for the mobile game Spirit Lords on iOS and Android built with Unity + Node.js

QA Lead - Managed a 2 person and outsource QA team. Created test plans, defined QA process and managed bug priorities. Coordinated game releases with multiple teams. 

QA Automation + Build Engineer - Helped create and manage a CI build system using Jenkins + Ant + C#(Unity). In charge of releasing builds on iTunesConnect and Google Play.  Source control used was SVN then moved to Perforce. Created some automated tests using a github project called Cukunity + Calabash iOS/Android.

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a small 5 person automation team for the following web games: Kingdoms of Camelot, Global Warfare, Glory of Rome, Thirst of Night which all used Javascript(FE) / PHP(BE). Team created frontend and backend automated tests to validate game features. Our automation framework was built in house using Java + Sikuli + Selenium WebDriver + Apache HTTP also used some TestNG

positions.title: CQC tester
positions.description: Job was two summers total of 7 months.

patents.title: System and method for integrated testing of a virtual space
patents.description: Created an automated testing framework for our web games using Java. Framework used Http libraries, sikuli, selenium, YAML to easily allow testers to create automated test cases.
